delivery.note: D-090 additive activities; unchanged v4 coordinate system and every original instance. Apply scenery overrides before rendering/collision; never draw both versions.

groundRules.selection: Explicit cells: sage planting zones, speckled stone lawns, cream path shoulders, clear Garden/plots/outlet lawn and full-size farm reserves. No camera reseeding.

exclusions.rule: Require separation from BOTH scenery world boundsPx (16 gap) and circle: nearest kid-box point distance >= exclusionRadiusWorld + 16. A ground circle alone does not enclose tall Garden roof. Ground/path reserve none.

garden.resolveSpawn: nearest free box outside all scenery envelopes and other kid boxes

composition.note: Six outer authoring destinations, clear central play lawn, closed perimeter plus three joined cross-walks. Four full-size farm bays below central walk. No home range: kids wander the whole map.

migration.note: Translate saved on-map positions, bring outside positions inside new bounds, then revalidate against scenery, plots, unlocked fields and other kids. Claude owns runtime migration.

plots.authority: relative grounds and transforms unchanged from gate4_v2; engine overlays unlocked plots, do not render this metadata as duplicate instances

suppressionNotes.reason: Clear occupied silhouettes or reachable ground approach. Preserve historical coordinates; omit only in v5.

activityDecorations.rule: Keep original instances as historical coordinate records, but exclude override IDs from rendering, collision and tap hit testing in v5. The two replaced landmarks use their exact original worldGround. Other IDs are small ornaments omitted for access. Never apply v3-to-v4 translation again.
activityDecorations.saveMigration: Coordinate offset [0,0]. Claude reconciles only saved kids newly intersecting activity footprints/occupied slots; preserve Garden, outlet, plots, fields, camera and all old coordinates.
